opener: RIA consolidation dominated the day, with Harborview, Crestline and Meridian each adding firms and two minority-stake deals announced. Regulators were also active, from a proposed SEC custody rule for crypto assets to enforcement actions by the SEC and FINRA. The Fed held rates steady.

items.summary: Harborview Wealth Partners, based in Seattle, has acquired Summit Ridge Advisors, an RIA with $1.2 billion in assets, with closing expected in the fourth quarter.
items.why_it_matters: Another sizable RIA sale points to continued buyer demand, which shapes valuations for advisors weighing a sale or succession plan.

items.summary: The Fed held rates steady and signaled one more cut this year.
items.why_it_matters: Advisors will field client questions on bond and cash positioning while the rate path stays uncertain.

items.summary: The SEC proposed changes to the custody rule for crypto assets that would narrow which firms count as qualified custodians.
items.why_it_matters: Advisors holding or recommending digital assets could face new custody requirements if the proposal is adopted.

items.summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management launched two active ETFs aimed at short-duration income.
items.why_it_matters: More active short-duration options widen the product shelf for income-focused client portfolios.

items.summary: Private-equity-backed Crestline Wealth closed its purchase of Riverbend Financial, a $900 million RIA, and is also set to buy Aspen Grove Advisors.
items.why_it_matters: PE-funded buyers doing multiple deals at once keep competition for independent practices high.

items.summary: Ledgerline launched an AI assistant that takes meeting notes for RIAs, following a $40 million funding round.
items.why_it_matters: Note-taking tools aim at the documentation load of client meetings, so compliance review of AI records becomes relevant.

items.summary: The SEC charged an Ohio investment adviser over a $3 million cherry-picking scheme, saying profitable trades went to the adviser's own accounts.
items.why_it_matters: Trade-allocation practices remain an enforcement focus, a reminder to review allocation policies and testing.

items.summary: Meridian Capital Partners completed its acquisition of Cedar Lane Private Wealth, an $850 million firm in Portland, Oregon.
items.why_it_matters: Deals involving Pacific Northwest practices show buyers looking beyond the largest metro markets.

items.summary: Bear Mountain Capital made a minority investment in Willowbrook Wealth.
items.why_it_matters: Minority stakes give founders capital while keeping control, an alternative to an outright sale.

items.summary: A wirehouse team managing $2.1 billion broke away to join Harborview Wealth Partners.
items.why_it_matters: Large wirehouse teams keep moving to independent firms, adding to recruiting competition for experienced advisors.

items.summary: FINRA fined a broker-dealer $1.5 million for supervision failures, including 1.2 million alerts it did not review; the firm neither admitted nor denied the findings.
items.why_it_matters: Alert backlogs are a supervisory risk that examiners penalize, so surveillance staffing deserves a look.

items.summary: Blue Heron Capital took a minority stake in Oakmont Family Office, a $2.3 billion firm serving 60 ultra-wealthy families.
items.why_it_matters: Outside capital is reaching family offices too, not only traditional RIAs.

items.summary: Northgate Advisors and Pinecrest Wealth are merging to form a $4.5 billion firm, with both founders serving as co-CEOs.
items.why_it_matters: Mergers of equals are an option for firms that want scale without selling to a larger acquirer.

items.summary: RIABiz looked at what the next generation of RIA founders wants from custodians.
items.why_it_matters: Custodians competing for new RIA founders may change the service and pricing on offer to breakaway advisors.

items.summary: The SEC reported 612 enforcement actions in fiscal year 2026.
items.why_it_matters: The annual totals show where the agency spent its enforcement effort, which helps firms set compliance priorities.
